name: DeepSteve Core
description: Session info, session close, issue spawning, terminal spawning

tools.name: get_my_session_id
tools.description: Get this session's deepsteve ID (no params needed)

tools.name: get_session_info
tools.description: Get session metadata by deepsteve session ID

tools.name: close_session
tools.description: Close a session and its browser tab

tools.name: meta_type
tools.description: Type text into a session's terminal and optionally press Enter

tools.name: read_session_screen
tools.description: Read the recent terminal screen of a session, plus its idle/busy state

tools.name: start_issue
tools.description: Open a new deepsteve session for a GitHub issue

tools.name: merge_worktree
tools.description: Merge this worktree's branch into the main checkout, server-side

tools.name: open_browser_tab
tools.description: Open a URL in a browser tab beside the session

tools.name: open_terminal
tools.description: Open a new long-lived tab: plain terminal by default, or a Claude/agent session if agent_type is passed

tools.name: run_in_terminal
tools.description: Run one command in a disposable terminal tab, return its output, and close the tab
